question:
Select the option that can be used as a one - word substitute for the given group of words.

An imagined place or state of things in which everything is perfect
solution:
The correct answer is: **Utopia**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"Utopia"** refers to an imagined place or state where everything is perfect, representing an ideal society or community. (आदर्शलोक)

 
 
• **Example: **In his book, the author describes a utopia where poverty and inequality do not exist, and peace reigns supreme.
 
 

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Utopia**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Dwarf** (बौना): A person, animal, plant or object much below the usual size.
 
 
• **Example:** The fairy tale featured a dwarf who offered sage advice to the lost travelers.
 
 
 
• **Chronology** (कालक्रम): The arrangement of events or dates in the order of their occurrence.
 
 
• **Example: **The historian presented a detailed chronology of the events leading up to the war.
 
 
 
• **Octogenarian** (अशीतिवर्षीय): A person who is from 80 to 89 years old.
 
 
• **Example:** The octogenarian shared stories from his youth with remarkable clarity and detail.
